summary: Import one provider-owned external evaluation host result by opaque reference after host admission verification.

inputs.name: provider_result_ref
inputs.description: Opaque provider result reference resolved by the host/provider boundary.

inputs.name: expected_result_digest
inputs.description: Optional sha256 digest guard for the provider-owned result artifact.

output.description: Imported host result reference and append-preserving admission/index receipts.

reads.surface: host/provider result resolver for opaque external-evaluation-provider-result:<id>

steps.description: Resolve the opaque provider result reference through the host/provider boundary, verify the returned host-admission verdict, and transactionally append result/admission indexes.

guards: Callers pass an opaque provider_result_ref, not a raw host result mapping.
The default AW CLI fails closed unless a protected host/provider resolver supplies the provider result and admission verdict.
Host admission verdict, capability revision/status, result digest, supersession, and revocation are re-resolved immediately before import.
Result and admission file/index writes are append-preserving, locally locked, idempotent, and rolled back together on partial failure.
Adapter receipt recording consumes only imported host_result_ref values.
proof: generated external consumer profile includes the operation
